title: Org-membership RLS: documents, comments, hash partitions
issue: Policy subqueries and functions are never planned as joins: per-row function calls, SubPlans, no join reordering, no partition pruning, nested-policy cost.
symptom: naive_rls (per-row plpgsql function) is orders of magnitude slower than the explicit semi-join baseline for selective subjects; best_practice_rls (InitPlan array) is still much slower for ORDER BY LIMIT / nested policies / partitions.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (and app.comments, app.documents_p). 100 docs per org, scale/20 users.

subjects.name: selective
subjects.note: member of ~2 orgs (~200 docs at 1M scale)
